MoinPDF direct editor font catalogue

These 56 local font faces are served by MoinPDF itself. No external font service
is used. All families include regular, bold, italic/oblique and bold italic/oblique.
The accompanying manifest records the exact file hashes.

Liberation Sans / Serif / Mono 2.1.5
Metric-compatible alternatives to Arial / Times New Roman / Courier New.
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LIBERATION-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts

Carlito 1.103
Metric-compatible alternative to Calibri.
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see CARLITO-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito

Caladea 1.002 (2013 release, not the differently licensed current release)
Metric-compatible alternative to Cambria.
Licence: Apache License 2.0; see CALADEA-LICENSE.txt and CALADEA-NOTICE.txt.
Source: LibreOffice bundled crosextrafonts-carlito/caladea distribution.

DejaVu Sans / Serif / Sans Mono / Sans Condensed / Serif Condensed 2.37
Licence: Bitstream Vera / DejaVu; see LICENSE and MANIFEST.json.
Source: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/

Noto Sans / Serif 2.015
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see NOTO-LATIN-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic

Rubik 1.100
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see RUBIK-LICENSE.txt and RUBIK-NOTICE.md.
Source: LibreOffice bundled libre-hebrew distribution.

Liberation Sans Narrow (1.07.6 distribution; font metadata reports 1.07.5)
Metric-compatible alternative to Arial Narrow.
Licence: GPL v2 with the Liberation font embedding exception;
see LIBERATION-NARROW-LICENSE.txt, LIBERATION-NARROW-COPYING.txt and
LIBERATION-NARROW-AUTHORS.txt.
Corresponding source is distributed with MoinPDF at:
/component-notices/browser-office/liberation-narrow-fonts-1.07.6.tar.gz

The additional font files are copied unmodified from the LibreOffice runtime
distribution. These are alternative families;
MoinPDF does not bundle or rename proprietary Microsoft font files.
Embedded fonts taken from a user's PDF are used only in that local document
session and output. Missing glyphs trigger an explicitly identified substitute.
